title: There Is A Light That Never Goes Out

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“百分之九十九隐形”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: About an hour east of Oakland, in the town of Livermore, California,
sentences.zh: 在奥克兰以东约一小时车程的加利福尼亚州利弗莫尔镇，

sentences.en: hanging in the garage of Fire Station No.
sentences.zh: 挂在消防六号
中队的车库里，

sentences.en: there's a small, pear-shaped light bulb.
sentences.zh: 有一个小型、梨形的灯泡。

sentences.en: The light bulb is on, right now.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，这个灯泡亮着。

sentences.en: It's glowing, and it's been glowing,
sentences.zh: 它在发光，而且它一直在发光，

sentences.en: with just a couple of momentary interruptions for 113 years.
sentences.zh: 除了偶尔几次短暂的闪失，已经亮了 113 年。

sentences.en: Oh, there it is!
sentences.zh: 哦，它就在那儿！

sentences.en: We're looking at the longest burning, longest continuously burning light bulb,
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是世界上燃烧时间最长、连续燃烧时间最长的灯泡，

sentences.en: in the world, it's in the Guinness Book of World Records,
sentences.zh: 它被收录在吉尼斯世界纪录中，

sentences.en: and it was installed in 1901.
sentences.zh: 并且它是在 1901 年安装的。

sentences.en: We send our producer, Katie Mingle, out there to see the bulb,
sentences.zh: 我们派我们的制片人凯蒂·明格去那里看这个灯泡，

sentences.en: which is a genuine heirloom from the dawn of electric illumination,
sentences.zh: 这是一个来自电灯照明黎明的真正传家宝，

sentences.en: built by one of its pioneers, a guy named Adolf Chalet.
sentences.zh: 由其先驱之一、一个叫阿道夫·夏莱的人制造。

sentences.en: Probably when you think about the beginning of electric light,
sentences.zh: 可能当你想到电灯的起源时，

sentences.en: you go immediately to Thomas Edison.
sentences.zh: 你首先就会想到托马斯·爱迪生。

sentences.en: That's John Muellem.
sentences.zh: 这是约翰·穆勒姆。

sentences.en: He's a writer from San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 他是来自旧金山的作家。

sentences.en: He wrote a piece about the Livermore light bulb for Pop-Up magazine earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，他为《弹出》杂志写了一篇关于利弗莫尔灯泡的文章。

sentences.en: But the age of electric light didn't just switch on all at once.
sentences.zh: 但电灯的时代并不是一下子就开启的。

sentences.en: You had tinkerers trying to come up with better designs,
sentences.zh: 当时有很多业余发明家试图设计出更好的东西，

sentences.en: trying to iterate and innovate,
sentences.zh: 试图不断迭代和创新，

sentences.en: something that would burn longer, or maybe brighter,
sentences.zh: 一种能燃烧更久、或者可能更亮的东西，

sentences.en: or that would cost less.
sentences.zh: 或者成本更低的东西。

sentences.en: So Chalet was one of these guys.
sentences.zh: 所以夏莱就是这些人中的一员。

sentences.en: It was a great time of invention and innovation.
sentences.zh: 那是一个充满发明与创新的伟大时代。

sentences.en: All over America, light bulbs were going off over people's heads,
sentences.zh: 在整个美国，人们的脑海中不断闪现出各种灵感，

sentences.en: and some of those light bulbs were being turned into actual light bulbs.
sentences.zh: 而其中一些灵感被转化为了真正的灯泡。

sentences.en: Chalet liked to do this whole theatrical product demo,
sentences.zh: 夏莱喜欢做一整套戏剧性的产品演示，

sentences.en: where he'd take a big light bulb back, the kind you'd see on a theater marquee.
sentences.zh: 他会拿回一个很大的灯泡，就是你在剧院招牌上看到的那种。

sentences.en: In it would be one bulb of his own design,
sentences.zh: 里面会装有一个他自己设计的灯泡，

sentences.en: and the rest would be bulbs from competing brands.
sentences.zh: 其余的都是竞争品牌的灯泡。

sentences.en: Then Chalet would start slowly dialing up the power,
sentences.zh: 然后夏莱开始慢慢调高功率，

sentences.en: and one by one, the competitor's bulbs would all explode.
sentences.zh: 竞争对手的灯泡就会一个接一个地全部爆炸。

sentences.en: Chalet's would be the last one shining.
sentences.zh: 最后亮着的将是夏莱的灯泡。

sentences.en: One of those tenacious light bulbs made it all the way to Livermore, California.
sentences.zh: 其中一个顽强的灯泡一路传到了加利福尼亚州的利弗莫尔。

sentences.en: Its origin was in 1901 when a shop owner donated it
sentences.zh: 它的源头是在 1901 年，当时一位店主将它捐赠

sentences.en: to the town's volunteer fire department.
sentences.zh: 给了该镇的志愿消防部门。

sentences.en: They were called the Fireboys in those days.
sentences.zh: 他们在那个年代被称为“消防男孩”。

sentences.en: And with the bulb hanging in their firehouse,
sentences.zh: 随着灯泡挂在他们的消防站里，

sentences.en: this meant they could now gather up all their equipment
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果半夜黑暗中接到火警电话，

sentences.en: if a call about a fire came in in the middle of the night, in the dark.
sentences.zh: 他们现在可以把所有的设备都收拾好。

sentences.en: In those dark ages, there were no fire engines.
sentences.zh: 在那个黑暗的时代，还没有消防车。

sentences.en: Firefighters used hose carts pulled by horses.
sentences.zh: 消防员使用的是由马拉的水龙软管车。

sentences.en: Here's Tom Bramwell, former deputy fire chief in Livermore.
sentences.zh: 这是利弗莫尔前副消防长官汤姆·布兰韦尔。

sentences.en: This tape of him is from a documentary about the bulb called Century of Light.
sentences.zh: 这段关于他的录音节选自一部名为《光之世纪》的关于该灯泡的纪录片。

sentences.en: The volunteers that arrived to an incident,
sentences.zh: 赶到现场的志愿者们，

sentences.en: they would come to the station there,
sentences.zh: 他们会来到那里的消防站，

sentences.en: get their hose cart, hitch up the horses,
sentences.zh: 拿到他们的水龙车，给马套上鞍具，

sentences.en: look for all of the equipment that they were looking for.
sentences.zh: 寻找他们需要的所有装备。

sentences.en: But this light lit up the hose cart room
sentences.zh: 但正是这盏灯照亮了水龙车房，

sentences.en: so that they could, without getting injured, falling over.
sentences.zh: 这样他们才不会受伤、不会摔倒。

sentences.en: So the light bulb served a very significant function.
sentences.zh: 所以这个灯泡发挥了非常重要的作用。

sentences.en: In 1906, the fire station moved just down the street.
sentences.zh: 1906 年，消防站搬到了街对面。

sentences.en: The light bulb had been on at that point for five years.
sentences.zh: 到那时，这个灯泡已经亮了五年了。

sentences.en: They had no idea how long it would last,
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道它能持续多久，

sentences.en: but it was their only light bulb.
sentences.zh: 但这是他们唯一的灯泡。

sentences.en: So of course, they brought it along.
sentences.zh: 所以理所当然地，他们把它一起带走了。

sentences.en: It seems like people just stopped thinking about the bulb after a while.
sentences.zh: 似乎过了一段时间后，人们就不再去想这个灯泡了。

sentences.en: There wasn't really an obvious way to shut it off,
sentences.zh: 由于它的接线方式，

sentences.en: the way that it had been wired,
sentences.zh: 当时并没有什么明显的方法可以把它关掉，

sentences.en: but it must have just been dim and unobtrusive enough
sentences.zh: 但它一定足够昏暗、足够不起眼，

sentences.en: that no one really tried too hard.
sentences.zh: 以至于没有人真正费心去管它。

sentences.en: Eventually, the old-fashioned hose carts were replaced with fire trucks.
sentences.zh: 最终，老式的软管车被消防车取代了。

sentences.en: The bulb hung between the firehouse's two garage doors,
sentences.zh: 灯泡悬挂在消防局两扇车库门之间，

sentences.en: and the firefighters were, like, aware of it,
sentences.zh: 消防员们虽然知道它的存在，

sentences.en: but they didn't think much about it.
sentences.zh: 但并没有把它放在心上。

sentences.en: The bulb hung down probably,
sentences.zh: 灯泡大概悬挂在……

sentences.en: well, hung down a pretty good distance from the ceiling
sentences.zh: 嗯，距离天花板有相当长的一段距离，

sentences.en: and on a long cord that it actually sits on today,
sentences.zh: 挂在一根长长的电线上，实际上现在它还挂在那根电线上，

sentences.en: the same cord.
sentences.zh: 还是同一根电线。

sentences.en: But it was pretty, it was low enough
sentences.zh: 但它挺低，低到

sentences.en: that you could walk by and actually reach up
sentences.zh: 你走过时甚至可以伸手

sentences.en: and tap the bulb and watch it swing back and forth.
sentences.zh: 拍一下灯泡，看着它来回摆动。

sentences.en: As time went on, we even would throw Nerf balls at it.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们甚至会向它扔纳夫软式球。

sentences.en: In 1971, the first full-time chief of the Livermore Fire Department,
sentences.zh: 1971 年，利弗莫尔消防局的第一任全职局长，

sentences.en: a guy named Jack Baird, got curious about the light bulb,
sentences.zh: 一个叫杰克·拜尔德的人，对这个灯泡产生了好奇，

sentences.en: and he asked a local newspaper reporter to look into the bulb's history.
sentences.zh: 他请当地的一名报社记者去调查这个灯泡的历史。

sentences.en: The resulting article got the residents of Livermore
sentences.zh: 随后的文章让利弗莫尔的居民们

sentences.en: talking about the bulb,
sentences.zh: 开始讨论这个灯泡，

sentences.en: and it became a point of pride,
sentences.zh: 它成了一个自豪的象征，

sentences.en: Livermore's own little antiquity.
sentences.zh: 利弗莫尔自己的小小古董。

sentences.en: The firefighters stopped throwing Nerf balls at it.
sentences.zh: 消防员们不再向它扔纳夫球了。

sentences.en: Five years later, when the fire department was moving into a new building,
sentences.zh: 五年后，当消防局搬进新大楼时，

sentences.en: they obviously knew that they couldn't leave the bulb behind,
sentences.zh: 他们显然知道不能把灯泡留在后面，

sentences.en: and in fact, Chief Baird insisted that they take it with them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，拜尔德局长坚持要把它带走。

sentences.en: On March the 31st, 1976,
it was the day that we moved the light bulb
sentences.zh: 那是我们把灯泡

sentences.en: from 2365 First Street out here on East Avenue to this station.
sentences.zh: 从第一街 2365 号东大道搬到这个消防站的日子。

sentences.en: That's Lynn Owens.
sentences.zh: 那是林恩·欧文斯。

sentences.en: He was the former division chief of the Livermore Fire Department.
sentences.zh: 他是利弗莫尔消防局的前分局长。

sentences.en: This interview was recorded for the Century of Light documentary released in 2011.
sentences.zh: 这段采访是为 2011 年发布的《光之世纪》纪录片录制的。

sentences.en: March 31st of 76 will always be a special day to me.
sentences.zh: 76 年的 3 月 31 日对我来说永远是一个特殊的日子。

sentences.en: The light bulb was escorted with red lights and a siren.
sentences.zh: 灯泡是在红灯闪烁和警报声的护送下转移的。

sentences.en: We had a special box built.
sentences.zh: 我们特地制作了一个箱子。

sentences.en: Not only that, but the box was painted red,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，这个箱子还被漆成了红色，

sentences.en: which even made it more special.
sentences.zh: 这让它显得更加特别。

sentences.en: When they got the light bulb to the new station,
sentences.zh: 当他们把灯泡运到新消防站时，

sentences.en: the electrician set it up so that the light bulb could be screwed in immediately.
sentences.zh: 电工将其安装好，以便灯泡可以立即拧上去。

sentences.en: He climbed up the ladder with the light bulb,
sentences.zh: 他带着灯泡爬上梯子，

sentences.en: screwed the wires together so that everything would go on.
sentences.zh: 把电线拧在一起以便通电。

sentences.en: And Frank made the connection.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克接好了线。

sentences.en: The light bulb didn't come on.
sentences.zh: 灯泡没有亮。

sentences.en: And we gasped.
sentences.zh: 我们倒吸了一口气。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Oh my goodness.
sentences.zh: 噢，我的天啊。

sentences.en: What did we do?
sentences.zh: 我们做了什么？

sentences.en: This world-famous light bulb, and now it's gone.
sentences.zh: 这个世界闻名的灯泡，现在居然不亮了。

sentences.en: But then the electrician jiggled some wires around.
sentences.zh: 但接着电工拨弄了几下电线。

sentences.en: The light came back on.
sentences.zh: 灯又亮了。

sentences.en: Everybody made a big sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 所有人都长舒了一口气。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, as the light bulb was becoming more and more famous,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，随着灯泡越来越出名，

sentences.en: it was impossible for people not to start wondering about what it was made of
sentences.zh: 人们不可避免地开始好奇它是用什么材料制造的，

sentences.en: and how it could still possibly be working.
sentences.zh: 以及它怎么可能还在工作。

sentences.en: The obvious way to solve the mystery would be to crack the light bulb open and examine it,
sentences.zh: 解开这个谜团的显而易见的方法就是把灯泡砸开检查一下，

sentences.en: but obviously no one wanted to do that.
sentences.zh: 但显然没有人想这么做。

sentences.en: It was just too precious.
sentences.zh: 它实在是太珍贵了。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Debra Katz.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是黛布拉·卡茨。

sentences.en: I'm a physics professor at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我是美国马里兰州安纳波利斯

sentences.en: Naval Academy in Annapolis, Maryland.
sentences.zh: 海军学院的物理学教授。

sentences.en: Dr. Katz did some tests on similar light bulbs,
sentences.zh: 卡茨博士对类似的灯泡做了一些测试，

sentences.en: light bulbs made by the same company in the same time period.
sentences.zh: 即同一时期由同一家公司制造的灯泡。

sentences.en: She measured the thickness of the bulb's filament,
sentences.zh: 她测量了灯泡灯丝的厚度，

sentences.en: which is that tiny piece of wire in the bulb that can break really easily.
sentences.zh: 也就是灯泡里那根极易断裂的极细电线。

sentences.en: And I did that using a laser, so I didn't have to break the bulb to get in there.
sentences.zh: 我是用激光测量的，所以我不需要砸碎灯泡就能进去测量。

sentences.en: She figured out that the filament in the Livermore bulb was eight times thicker than a regular bulb
sentences.zh: 她发现利弗莫尔灯泡的灯丝比普通灯泡厚八倍，

sentences.en: and made from carbon instead of tungsten.
sentences.zh: 并且是用碳而不是钨制成的。

sentences.en: What I figured out doesn't tell me why the filament shouldn't have broken by now.
sentences.zh: 我弄明白的事并不能告诉我为什么这根灯丝到现在还没断。

sentences.en: That's pretty incredible.
sentences.zh: 这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I think it still is a mystery.
sentences.zh: 我认为这依然是一个谜。

sentences.en: What she does know is that in 1924,
sentences.zh: 她所知道的是，在 1924 年，

sentences.en: a bunch of light bulb companies got together and formed a cartel called Phoebus.
sentences.zh: 一群灯泡公司聚在一起，成立了一个名为“福玻斯”的卡特尔（企业垄断同盟）。

sentences.en: The goal of the cartel was for all the light bulb companies to stop making bulbs that lasted so long
sentences.zh: 这个卡特尔的目标是让所有灯泡公司停止制造寿命那么长的灯泡，

sentences.en: so that everyone could sell more light bulbs.
sentences.zh: 以便每个人都能卖出更多的灯泡。

sentences.en: Members of the cartel were actually charged fines if their bulbs burned for too many hours.
sentences.zh: 如果卡特尔成员的灯泡燃烧时间超过了规定的小时数，实际上会被处以罚款。

sentences.en: And in two years, the company's light bulbs went from lasting 2,500 hours down to 1,500 hours.
sentences.zh: 在两年内，该公司灯泡的寿命从 2500 小时缩短到了 1500 小时。

sentences.en: And by the 1940s, they actually made their goal of bulbs that only last 1,000 hours.
sentences.zh: 到了 20 世纪 40 年代，他们真正实现了只持续 1000 小时的灯泡的目标。

sentences.en: The Shelby Company, which manufactured Chalet's bulb,
sentences.zh: 制造了夏莱灯泡的谢尔比公司，

sentences.en: had already gone out of business by the time the Phoebus cartel had been formed.
sentences.zh: 在福玻斯卡特尔成立时就已经倒闭了。

sentences.en: But I'd like to think that they wouldn't have been involved with that nonsense.
sentences.zh: 但我愿意相信他们不会参与那种无聊的勾当。

sentences.en: I think they were trying to make a quality product rather than a product with built-in obsolescence.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们努力在制造优质产品，而不是带有内置淘汰机制的产品。

sentences.en: And a quality product it was.
sentences.zh: 它确实是一款优质产品。

sentences.en: This whole time, of course, the bulb was just hanging there and continuing to glow.
sentences.zh: 当然，这段时间里，灯泡一直挂在那里，并继续发光。

sentences.en: So in a way, its story was taking on this air of magical realism.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，它的故事呈现出一种魔幻现实主义的色彩。

sentences.en: In 2001, a group of locals decided Livermore ought to have a 100th birthday party for the light bulb.
sentences.zh: 2001 年，一群当地人决定为这个灯泡举办一场百岁生日派对。

sentences.en: They formed the Centennial Bulb Committee and started planning what they thought would be a small get-together at the firehouse that June.
sentences.zh: 他们成立了百年灯泡委员会，开始策划他们以为会在那年 6 月在消防站举行的小型聚会。

sentences.en: In the end, 600 people showed up and they had cake and there were rock bands playing and kids dancing on the top of the firetruck.
sentences.zh: 最后，来了 600 人，大家吃了蛋糕，有乐队在演奏，孩子们在消防车顶上跳舞。

sentences.en: Committee members gave live interviews to Katie Couric and CNN.
sentences.zh: 委员会成员接受了凯蒂·库里克和美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）的现场采访。

sentences.en: By then, responsibility for the bulb had passed from Chief Baird, he was the first fireman to become interested in the bulb,
sentences.zh: 到那时，灯泡的管理责任已经从贝尔德局长转移了，他是第一个对这盏灯产生兴趣的消防员，

sentences.en: to one of the firefighters who served under him, Lynn Owens.
sentences.zh: 转交给了曾在他手下服役的消防员林恩·欧文斯。

sentences.en: You heard from him earlier.
sentences.zh: 你刚才听过他的录音了。

sentences.en: Owens had been one of the younger guys in the 70s who'd sat around chucking Nerf footballs at the light bulb.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代，欧文斯还是个年轻人，经常坐在一旁拿美式海绵橄榄球砸灯泡。

sentences.en: But by this point, by the time the bulb turned 100, he was already a retired division chief.
sentences.zh: 但到了这个时候，也就是灯泡满百岁的时候，他已经是一名退休的副局长了。

sentences.en: He was this grinning, aging guy with these tiny glasses and a bristly white mustache.
sentences.zh: 他是一个满脸笑容、上了年纪的人，戴着一副小小的眼镜，留着一把刚硬的白胡子。

sentences.en: Owens loved the bulb, and he loved to proclaim his love.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯深爱着这盏灯，并且乐于表达这种爱。

sentences.en: That light bulb is dependable.
sentences.zh: 那盏灯非常可靠。

sentences.en: That light bulb has been doing the job it was intended to do since 1901.
sentences.zh: 那盏灯自1901年以来一直在履行它预定的职责。

sentences.en: It was like he was talking about the light bulb the way James Earl Jones talked about baseball at the end of Field of DreaMs.
sentences.zh: 感觉他谈论灯泡的方式，就像詹姆斯·厄尔·琼斯在《梦幻之地》结尾谈论棒球一样。

sentences.en: It reminds us of all that once was good.
sentences.zh: 它让我们想起了过去所有美好的事物。

sentences.en: Actually, that's how a lot of people end up talking about the light bulb, though.
sentences.zh: 不过说实话，很多人谈起这盏灯时最终都是这种语气。

sentences.en: People write letters to the committee, and they say things like the light bulb gives them hope,
sentences.zh: 人们给委员会写信，说的话诸如灯泡给了他们希望，

sentences.en: or they call it, quote, a reassuring reminder of faithfulness and service.
sentences.zh: 或者称它为“忠诚与服务令人安心的提醒”。

sentences.en: In a letter President George W.
sentences.zh: 在一封信中，乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush called the light bulb, quote, an enduring symbol of the American spirit of invention, end quote.
sentences.zh: 布什总统称这盏灯为“美国发明精神的永恒象征”。

sentences.en: For a lot of people, it also ironically symbolizes another great American invention, planned obsolescence.
sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，讽刺的是，它也象征着另一个伟大的美国发明——计划性废旧。

sentences.en: I like the light bulb because it's this little speck of continuity.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这盏灯，因为它就像是历史长河中一点小小的连续性。

sentences.en: You know, it's something that started more than a century ago, and it keeps going.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是在一个多世纪前开始的事物，而且它一直在延续。

sentences.en: So it sort of connects us to that time.
sentences.zh: 所以它在某种程度上把我们和那个时代联系在了一起。

sentences.en: You can almost imagine it like this little ember of a campfire that was lit back then and is still glowing.
sentences.zh: 你几乎可以把它想象成当时点燃、至今仍在发光的一小块篝火余烬。

sentences.en: And kind of in the same way, if you trace that history, you see these waves of people coming to gather around that fire
sentences.zh: 用类似的方式，如果你顺着这段历史追溯，你会看到一拨又一拨的人聚集在这团火周围，

sentences.en: and then slowly leaving the picture and new ones coming in.
sentences.zh: 然后又慢慢淡出画面，新的人又加入进来。

sentences.en: The light bulb outlived Jack Baird, the first fire chief who became curious about it,
sentences.zh: 这盏灯的寿命超过了杰克·贝尔德，他是第一个对它产生好奇的消防局长，

sentences.en: and Lynn Owens, its most devoted caretaker.
sentences.zh: 也超过了林恩·欧文斯，它最忠诚的守护者。

sentences.en: Chalet's light bulb has seen generations of firefighters come and go through Livermore.
sentences.zh: 沙莱特的这盏灯见证了一代又一代的消防员在利弗莫尔进进出出。

sentences.en: So in 2001, right around the time of the party, the Centennial Bulb Committee also set up a webcam in front of the light bulb.
sentences.zh: 因此在2001年，就在庆祝活动举行之际，百年灯泡委员会还在灯泡前安装了一个网络摄像头。

sentences.en: The camera takes a picture of the bulb every 30 seconds so that people all over the world can make sure that it's still on.
sentences.zh: 这个摄像头每30秒给灯泡拍一张照片，好让全世界的人都能确认它还亮着。

sentences.en: The guy who maintains the camera is named Steve Bunn.
sentences.zh: 负责维护这个摄像头的人叫史蒂夫·邦恩。

sentences.en: And he told me he's already had to replace the supposedly high-tech webcam two times
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他已经不得不更换过两次那个号称高科技的网络摄像头了，

sentences.en: because the light bulb has outlasted both of those devices.
sentences.zh: 因为这盏灯的寿命比这两台设备都要长。

sentences.en: The bulb has its own standby generator, something inaccurately named the Uninterruptible Power Supply.
sentences.zh: 这灯泡有它自己的备用发电机，一个名字不太准确的设备，叫做不间断电源。

sentences.en: It zonked out suddenly in the middle of the night in May of 2013.
sentences.zh: 2013年5月的一个深夜，它突然罢工了。

sentences.en: And when it did, the light bulb went dark.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，灯泡熄灭了。

sentences.en: Steve told me that when it happened, people around the world who happened to be watching the webcam at that point
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫告诉我，当时正巧在通过网络摄像头观看的世界各地的人们，

sentences.en: saw the bulb wink out and started calling or emailing him panicked, you know, or just in disbelief.
sentences.zh: 看到灯泡突然熄灭，惊慌失措地给他打电话或发邮件，你知道的，或者只是感到难以置信。

sentences.en: The bulb was out for nine hours and 42 minutes before someone was finally able to get over to the firehouse and rake up an extension cord.
sentences.zh: 灯泡熄灭了9小时42分钟，直到终于有人赶到消防局接上了延长线。

sentences.en: When it was turned back on, Steve said, everyone swore it looked brighter.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫说，当灯重新亮起时，大家都发誓看起来更亮了。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by John Moellum and Katie Mingle with Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由约翰·莫勒姆和凯蒂·明格制作，参与制作的还有萨姆·格林斯潘、艾弗里·特拉夫曼以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Christopher Leps, who allowed us to use audio from his film Century of Light.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢克里斯托弗·莱普斯，他允许我们使用其电影《光之世纪》中的音频。

sentences.en: You can find a link to the film on our website.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到该电影的链接。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 local public radio KALW in San Francisco and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7地方公共广播电台KALW的一个项目，制作办公室位于ArcSign，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm located in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 这是一家建筑与室内设计公司，坐落于美丽加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: Let's stay safe out there, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家在外出时请注意安全。

sentences.en: You can find 99% Invisible and like us on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到《99%隐形》并为我们点赞。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我的推特账号是Roman Mars。

sentences.en: Avery runs this killer Tumblr for us.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里为我们运营着这个超棒的Tumblr账号。

sentences.en: But for links and pictures and lists of songs and all the back episodes, go to 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 但若想获取链接、图片、歌曲列表以及所有往期节目，请访问99pi.org。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
